noChildFields.description: Don't build documentation for fields and methods when called on a type.

noMixinFields.description: Exclude fields and methods inherited from mixins (and not overridden on the type).

noPrivateFields.description: Exclude fields and methods marked as private in this type.

noUses.description: Exclude cross-references for key usages of a type.

noSee.description: Exclude `@see` links on type and field documentation.

exampleLang.description:
Extract example code for the specified language. Examples are identified with the `@example` annotation.

This is exclusive with #exampleAllLangs. (If that field is set, this one is ignored.)

exampleAllLangs.description:
Include example code for all supported languages. Examples are identified with the `@example` annotation.

This is exclusive with #exampleLang. (If this field is set, that one is ignored).

synthesizeExamples.description:
If true, examples will be synthesized for standard cases, such as Obj construction and field access. These code
snippets use randomly generated values so provide a serviceable, but not very enlightening, example. To enable
this behavior, this field must be set _and_ either #exampleLang or #exampleAllLangs.

pkg.description: Specify the package to be used for loading types and topic files (instead of the package of the current app).

contentType.description:
The MIME type of output to render. Supported MIME types are:
 - text/html
 - text/markdown
 - text/plain

linkBuilder.description:
Resolve references in documentation not on the same page. These generally occur due to `@link` in `.c3typ` files
or Markdown style links in `.c3doc` files. If unspecified, normal web links render naturally and other links are
removed.

Note that the link _syntax_ is associated with the MIME type, but the _target_ of the link is dependent on the
context for which rendering is being one. The link builder is used to produce the context-specific link target.

@see DocumentationReference

noHashLinks.description:
Suppress on-page links (`#`) for references to content generated on this page. This will send _all_ links through
the #linkBuilder for processing.

synthesizeTitle.description: Only applicable to DocumentationKind.TOPIC. Include a heading tag using the title field from the MultiMarkdown metadata.

includeCss.description:
If true, include Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) that complete the presentation and support features such as syntax
coloring. Note that this provides the style used for the documentation micro-site, which may not be appropriate
for all presentations.

The emitted styles are surrounded by `<!-- start css -->` and `<!-- end css -->` comments to allow them to be
identified. The documentation content is surrounded by `<!-- start content -->` and `<!-- end content -->` comments
plus a `<div class="content">` tag.

This only has an effect when rendering in HTML, and some features require #includeJs also.

cssMode.description:
If {@link #includeCSS CSS is included}, whether light or dark mode will be used, or "auto" which will adapt to
the system setting.

includeJs.description:
If true, JavaScript that completes the implementation of some features such as syntax coloring, math, and Mermaid
diagrams will be included.

The emitted scripts are surrounded by `<!-- start js -->` and `<!-- end js -->` comments to allow them to be
identified. The documentation content is surrounded by `<!-- start content -->` and `<!-- end content -->` comments
plus a `<div class="content">` tag.

This only has an effect when rendering in HTML, and some features need styling (such as by #includeCss) also.

standAlone.description:
If true, generate a complete stand-alone document. For example, HTML rendering will produce appropriate `html`,
`head` and `body` tags.

title:
Generic argument to documentation rendering functions.
@see DocumentationRenderer
